### Zenas Who?
Author: John Sartelle
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/zenas-who
Passage: Titus 3:12-13
Points:
- Paul's closing instructions name everyday companions and travel details that history has mostly forgotten.
- Believers are called to labor for Christ rather than seek worldly recognition or remembrance.
- Ministry belongs to God, who sovereignly directs the laborers, the plans, and the outcomes.
- Faithful, unnoticed service in obscure settings is fully known and valued by God.

### Four Lessons in Fruitful Time-Management
Author: David Mathis
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/four-lessons-in-fruitful-time-management
Passage: Titus 3:14
Points:
- Engaging in fruitful good works to meet urgent needs requires deliberate practice and learning.
- Christians should recognize their present vocational calling and schedule their highest priorities first.
- Making the most of morning hours enables proactive productivity in serving others.
- Disciplined scheduling builds margin to respond flexibly to unexpected needs as they arise.
- Pouring out energy and time in loving service produces true and lasting joy.
